args.query: Stride shoe recycling program worn-out shoes

responses.content: Absolutely! Stride has a **Take‑back program** for worn‑out shoes. Just send us the pair with the free label we’ll provide, and we’ll recycle them into playground surfaces. For each pair you’ll receive a $10 voucher toward your next purchase [[sustainability#take-back-program]]. Let me know if you’d like the label sent to you!
